title: Dj Akademiks Reveals What He Has Been Told About Megan Thee Stallion & Tory Lanez Incident & Says Everyone Curves Meg For Kylie Jenner

From what I'm hearing, she's a little bit more outgoing in terms of trying to hit up other people this, and third, from what I've heard, it's been multiple and numerous times that she is like a guy that she's met through the industry and Meg just [f***ed] them. Okay, that's just what the narrative is, at least in the industry," said Akademiks.
